name: wot-agent-communication
description: This project is a mashup of a [CArtAgO](https://sourceforge.net/projects/cartago/) artifact for [JaCoMo](https://github.com/jacamo-lang/jacamo) and [node-wot](https://www.thingweb.io/).  It enables agents to communicate via Web of Things protocols and discover other agents and what they are capable of using a Thing Description.
